::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 8th 1874  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell
:::

Dear [Mr Palgrave](people/person_1124.qmd)
I am afraid your [Lyme Garland](other_books/otherbook_786.qmd)may have been waiting some time for my return from a course of visits, as I only found it on my coming home on Saturday

Thank you exceedingly for the kind remembrance  The music of your verse always charms me, I think my special favorites are the primroses and the lament for the Baby

yours very truly
C M Yonge
